newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 30 Kurd rebels killed in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 30 Kurd rebels killed in clashes.

text.p: Turkish security officials said on Saturday that troops had killed 30 Kurdistan Workers Party guerrillas in two days of clashes in the mountainous southeast of the country.
Regional officials said in a statement that the clashes, in the provinces of Diyarbakir and Siirt, had taken place on Friday and Saturday. The statement gave no details of any military casualties.
More than 22,000 people have died in 12 years of conflict between troops and the rebels, fighting for self-rule in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
